correctness.rationale: Rotation invariance and test-profile partition reduce every program to a regular language over the two inverse moves. Effective semilinearity and a Bezout/residue argument prove the exact gcd criterion for loop, with the zero-generator case producing only finite exceptions. Mutual induction covers arbitrary nesting and diamonds. Explicit program-loop formulas recover every prime-power divisibility predicate and every singleton, proving converse completeness. CRT separates residue-one modulo four. The standalone checker passed 5280 semantic plus 2210 arithmetic finite cases, with no reliance on them as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete, effective and genuinely restrictive invariant for an infinite family of finite transition systems; arbitrary nested loop, converse and tests collapse exactly to a gcd/finitely exceptional arithmetic Boolean algebra. Explicit construction establishes the converse, and separation from all ultimately periodic predicates identifies a non-obvious expressive boundary. This is more than a routine deduction or finite computation.
